in_marathi.name: Nivanansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nivanansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nivanansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Niv' meaning victory and 'Anansh' meaning God. This name signifies the victory of God over all obstacles and challenges in life.
